rules.statement: The passage of time alone is not a sufficient basis to discharge the person from custody for extradition under section 11(3)(b) of the Extradition Law, unless it can be shown that such delay would cause prejudice and result in injustice.
rules.supporting_quote: "Applying the said observations, I hold /that the mere fact that a period of ten years has elapsed since the commission of the alleged offences does not by itself constitute a sufficient basis to discharge the corpus in terms of section 11 (3) (b) of the Extradition Law."

meta.parties: Lady Benwell v. The Attorney General and Another
